title: Trump's Iran Sequencing Kept Accountability Clarity Under Strain
description_short: Trump's Iran Sequencing Kept Accountability Clarity Under Strain
description_medium: On February 27, 2026, Trump said he was unhappy with the Iran nuclear talks but had not made a final decision. About three hours later, aboard Air Force One, he ordered Operation Epic Fury. AP reported that he discussed continuing negotiations or striking Iran with Republican lawmakers during the flight. Oman’s foreign minister later said a deal had been within reach.
description_long: The Associated Press reconstructed the hours before Trump ordered Operation Epic Fury on February 27, 2026. At 12:25 p.m., Trump said he was unhappy with Iran’s nuclear talks while indicating that he had not made a final decision. Roughly three hours later, aboard Air Force One, he ordered strikes. AP reported that Trump discussed the choice between continuing negotiations and launching a strike with Republican lawmakers during the flight. Oman’s foreign minister Badr Albusaidi, whose government had helped mediate the talks, later said an agreement had been within reach and expressed dismay that the negotiations had been undermined. The chronology places Trump’s public remarks, the deliberation AP describes, and the mediator’s account alongside one another. It shows that negotiations remained part of the choice Trump discussed shortly before ordering military action. The report does not identify a formal accountability review or establish which decision criteria officials used. The title’s claim about accountability clarity therefore needs a specific documented process to support it.

preserved_fields.title: Trump's Iran Sequencing Kept Accountability Clarity Under Strain
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump's Iran Sequencing Kept Accountability Clarity Under Strain

notes: Reason: AP’s timeline supports the sequence of remarks, discussions, strike order, and Oman’s mediator’s assessment, but not a specific accountability process or unclear decision criteria. Proposed correction: retitle around Trump’s February 27 remarks and strike order, or add reporting that documents the accountability process claimed in the current title.
proposed_correction: AP Timeline: Iran-Talk Criticism Preceded Trump’s Strike Order by About Three Hours
